name: Biogena Good Vibes AG
summary: Biogena Good Vibes AG develops, produces, and distributes health and nutrition products and services. The company's products include vitamins, minerals, trace elements, amino acids, gut bacteria, omega 3 fatty acids, fibre, collagen, hyaluronic acid, coenzyme q10, enzymes, antioxidants, botanicals, algae, functional mushrooms, greens, MSM, melatonin, organic cold pressed oils, cologne, functional food and drinks, specials, and accessories. Biogena Good Vibes AG was founded in 2006 and is based in Salzburg, Austria.
